hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '[^[:alnum:]]gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+create([^[:alnum:]]|$)'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Before creating this PR, run the anti-slop audit agent to verify description-diff alignment and commit quality."}}'; fi
hooks.description: Remind to run the anti-slop audit before gh pr create
